objective: Build durable recurring revenue by preserving important software after ordinary maintenance economics fail.
public_product: A continuously updated extinction index for open-source dependencies.
paid_product: Continuity contracts: compatible signed releases, security backports, runtime bridges, and response-time commitments.
laws: Never count attention, signups, grants, promises, or nominal bounties as revenue.
Never adopt a project without a compatible license and an explicit non-impersonation name.
Prefer cooperation, transfer, sponsorship, or co-maintenance with the original maintainers before forking.
Never promise security or compatibility that has not been continuously tested.
Every investment decision must cite live demand, abandonment, migration pain, and commercial evidence.
Every experiment has a cost ceiling, a deadline, and a kill condition.
Profitable contracts fund the next maintained package; unsupported products are retired cleanly rather than silently abandoned.
